title: I made a weekly TV show with Claude and this is Episode 5!
author: Slackluster
selftext:
Almost Television is a 12-minute puppet sketch show on YouTube that I make with Claude in Claude Code, a new episode most Saturdays; Episode 5, For When I'm Grown Up, is out today.

I'm the showrunner and give notes; Claude writes and directs with me, and we built the 3D puppet engine together (three.js, from scratch), so every frame is rendered, no video model. New this time is Backstage: three short pieces inside the episode where a puppet host shows how it really works, with robot writers reading pitches and giving notes ("Needs more Otto"), a set that builds itself out of code, and an automated check that flags a newsreader who said "moose". It's all true to the pipeline, played for laughs.

The rest of the week went on notes: where a puppet's eyes land on a letter it's reading, a hand that snapped when a scene cut, a mug that went into a chest; Claude built small checkers for each so they don't come back.

Episode 5: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wesrpFLIlAI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wesrpFLIlAI)

Happy to answer anything.
